summary.text: Hugh Blackwell is a Republican state representative from North Carolina House District 86 who has served since 2009 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
The General Assembly lists him as a retired attorney representing Burke County.

paragraphs.text: Blackwell's professional experience includes working as an attorney.
He assumed office in the North Carolina House in 2009, and the General Assembly's website lists him in his ninth House term.
In the 2025-2026 session Blackwell chairs the Appropriations, Election Law, House Select Committee on Involuntary Commitment and Public Safety, and House Select Committee on Redistricting committees.
He is co-chair of the Joint Legislative Education Oversight Committee and the Joint Legislative Elections Oversight Committee.
